newsitem.title: USA: H-P lowers price on color printer.
newsitem.headline: H-P lowers price on color printer.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co Tuesday said it lowered the price of its HP DesignJet 755CM large-format color inkjet printer by $1,000 to $10,995.

"We've seen a substantial decrease in memory prices, and when our costs go down, we pass the savings along to our customers," said Bernard Meric, general manager of H-P's DesignJet Division in Barcelona, Spain.

"Large-format printers are becoming pervasive in many areas, and they are being put to new uses every day. Lower prices should aid in the growth of the market and help more people realize the value of cost-effective large-format printers such as H-P's DesignJet printers."
